title: Health card issuance announcement
description: A City Health Office announcement says health card issuance began January 7, 2026, at the 5th floor of Gaisano Ilustre.
notes: Past announcement. Confirm the current schedule and venue with the City Health Office.

title: Earlier health card schedule announcement
description: An earlier City Health Office announcement listed health card issuance at NCCC Mall Victoria Plaza from January 2 to June 30.
notes: Past announcement. Confirm the current schedule and venue with the City Health Office.

title: Pasko Fiesta All Over the City 2026 application opens
description: The City Tourism Operations Office invited Davao City barangays and private establishments to register for the Christmas displays and activities competition. The City announcement lists a November 30, 2026 registration deadline and judging dates in December.
notes: Dates come from the City announcement and have not received Requisito's independent review.

title: Davao City tourism projects receive 2026 ATOP Pearl Awards distinctions
description: A City Information Office report dated October 21, 2026 says the Kadayawan Festival 2025 official video was named second runner-up in a tourism-promotion category and KAGIKAN: The Kadayawan Cultural Village was a finalist in a sustainable-tourism category.
notes: Award claims are summarized from the linked City article; the article and award details have not been independently reviewed.

title: Davao City reconstitutes Lupong Tagapamayapa Incentives committee
description: A City Information Office report says Executive Order No. 36, series of 2026, reconstituted the Lupong Tagapamayapa Incentives Awards-City Awards Committee. The report links to the City executive-orders archive.
notes: The summary is not legal advice; consult the original order in the City archive.
